Sara - Support: FYI — CSM Emily escalated: customer ZedPay reports invoice looks ~4x higher than dashboard for 2026-03-14 to 2026-03-15. Customer expects ~300k tokens but invoice shows ~1.2M. please triage :eyes:
Emily - CSM: Customer provided screenshots of billing dashboard vs PDF invoice, timestamped. They say billing UI shows 298,412 tokens, invoice line item lists 1,198,412 tokens. They want a credit and root-cause. Customer is on monthly contract, paying card on file.
Sara - Support: I created an internal ticket and flagged to finance + eng. Posting quick logs and observed anomalies below.
Michael - Eng: Can you paste example request IDs or any ingestion logs? Need to know if this is metering bug, backfill, or duplicate ingestion.
Sara - Support: Here's a minimal snippet from ingestion logs around the spike window (trimmed):
```
2026-03-15T02:12:03Z | req_id=abc123 | tenant=zedpay | tokens=512 | status=200
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z | req_id=abc123 | tenant=zedpay | tokens=512 | status=200  # duplicate
2026-03-15T02:12:10Z | req_id=retry-xyz | tenant=zedpay | tokens=2048 | status=408
2026-03-15T02:12:11Z | req_id=retry-xyz | tenant=zedpay | tokens=2048 | status=200
```
Sara - Support: We see repeated req_id values and a couple of retries that later succeeded. Customer claims they only sent the call once.
OpsBot: Metering backfill job completed for shard-12 at 2026-03-15T04:05:12Z (job_id=mb-20260315-12)
BillingBot: Audit record: invoice-generation run for tenant zedpay on 2026-03-15T06:00:01Z included 1,198,412 tokens (source: metering-agg v2.4).
Michael - Eng: Quick hypothesis — earlier dedup key used was request-id header, but we rolled an edge proxy change that changed how retries were surfaced; duplicates escaped dedup window and got double-counted. I pushed a fix 2026-03-15T03:20 and will run a correction script to remove duplicates from the aggregated table. :shipit:
Aj - Finance: From finance side, we need: 1) confirmed corrected token count, 2) amount to credit, and 3) a revrec note for the GL. If corrected tokens are 298,412 like dashboard, we can issue a credit for the difference (estimated $1,020). Please confirm asap.
Sara - Support: Agree — Eng to confirm corrected counts. Michael, can you run the correction and provide corrected metrics and SQL we used so Finance can record revrec?
Michael - Eng: Running the de-dupe backfill now against metering-prod-agg. I'll post the query and results. ETA ~25m.
(25 minutes pass)
Michael - Eng: Backfill done. Query used:
```
-- remove duplicates where identical req_id and identical payload within 2min window
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY tenant, req_id, tokens ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM metering_prod.events
  WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-14' AND '2026-03-16' AND tenant='zedpay'
)
DELETE FROM metering_prod.events WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM ranked WHERE rn>1);
```
Michael - Eng: After dedupe, aggregated tokens for zedpay in that window = 298,512 (diff 899,900 tokens).
Aj - Finance: Confirming math: invoice counted 1,198,412; corrected 298,512 -> delta 899,900 tokens. Rate is $0.0012/token? (replace with contracted rate) that would be ~$1,079.88. We'll draft a credit memo for that amount pending legal/ops sign-off. Please provide final memo text and a short revrec reason code.
Sara - Support: Drafting credit note to customer now, CC'ing Emily for approval.
Emily - CSM: Customer accepted preliminary plan and asked for timeline. They asked for statement showing corrected numbers for their accounting.
Aj - Finance: Revrec note should be: "Metering correction due to duplicate ingestion from edge retry bug; backfill applied 2026-03-15; ticket SPT-10234; credit memo CM-2026-041." Please include this in the ledger entry.
Sara - Support: Noted. I will attach the backfill SQL, eng playbook, and link to ticket SPT-10234 on the support portal.
Michael - Eng: Root cause writeup (short): Edge proxy returned 408 intermittently on first attempt for a small percentage of traffic. Client-side automatic retries with same req-id caused idempotency to fail because dedupe used transient header. We changed dedupe to include hash(payload) and extended dedupe window to 5 minutes. Fix deployed 2026-03-15T03:20.
Aj - Finance: Once we have the final corrected tokens in CSV and the support ticket link, Finance will issue the credit and post a GL adjustment with revrec note. I will email invoice copy + credit memo to zedpay accounting.
BillingBot: Credit memo CM-2026-041 created against invoice INV-2026-8812 for tenant zedpay (amount $1,079.88).
Sara - Support: Closing loop with customer now. Emily, can you share the customer message that they prefer the credit vs refund to card?
Emily - CSM: Customer prefers invoice credit. They asked for a brief statement of root cause for their records — will send once we receive the short cause statement.
Sara - Support: I'll send the standardized one-liner and attach the backfill SQL and support ticket. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
